name: milpa/framework
description: The composer create-project starting point for a Milpa app: a runtime whose every capability is a declared Operation, reachable from the terminal, from MCP and from a TUI at once. No database, no web framework — an agent-operable substrate you extend with plugins.

suggest.milpa/agent: Sessions that outlive the process: plan, todos, permissions and `coa chat`
suggest.milpa/ai-gateway: Let the agent RUN: a model on the other side of `coa agent`
suggest.milpa/auth: Identity: turns a Bearer into an actor with scopes
suggest.milpa/data: Persistence for tokens and entities, with four backends
suggest.milpa/devtools: Scaffolding and diagnosis: `coa make`, `coa validate`, `coa doctor`
suggest.milpa/mcp-server: The same operations exposed to an external MCP client
